description: Author an agent skill from text: name, description, instruction body, and an optional slash command. Team scope requires admin or owner, private scope is your own. A command must be lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, must not be one of the reserved commands, and must be free in the organization, as must the skill name. Refused once the per-user or per-organization skill limit is reached. Use skills.upload or skills.from-url.import for a packaged skill instead.
